title: Algebraization of prescribed local deformations with finite-jet stalk comparisons
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $R=k[[t]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], and $X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] with dimension at most one [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $p_i$, indexed by $\operatorname{Fin}r$, be distinct closed points such that $X$ is smooth off their range [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. For each $i$ let $B_i$ be a local, flat, essentially finite type $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map, def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra] with the induced $k$-algebra structure and a $k$-algebra isomorphism $B_i/tB_i\simeq\mathcal O_{X,p_i}$. Then there is a flat finitely presented H-projective $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation, def-kun-projective], with special-fibre isomorphism $e:Y_k\simeq X$ over $k$, and morphisms $j_n:X\to Y_{n+1}$ for every $n\geq0$, where $Y_{n+1}=Y\times_R\operatorname{Spec}(R/(t^{n+1}))$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Their composites to $Y$ equal $e^{-1}$ followed by the special-fibre inclusion. There are ring isomorphisms $h_{i,n}:\mathcal O_{Y_{n+1},j_n(p_i)}\simeq B_i/(t^{n+1})$ carrying the germ of each base scalar $a\bmod t^{n+1}$ to its image in $B_i/(t^{n+1})$. The marked list and the schemes may be empty. No comparison between the unreduced local rings of $Y$ and $B_i$ is asserted.

proof.text: For R=k[[t]], put P_n=(t)^{n+1}, J_{i,n}=P_n B_i and C_{i,n}=B_i/J_{i,n}. The special-fibre isomorphism makes J_{i,0} proper, and J_{i,n} is contained in it. Thus the quotients are nonzero local rings. Flatness follows by the quotient/tensor isomorphism and flat base change. Essential finite type follows by composition with the surjection B_i onto its quotient.

Apply the distinguished-polynomial quotient equivalence for X^{n+1} to identify k[t]/(t^{n+1}) with R/P_n. On representatives the map sends a polynomial to the same power series modulo t^{n+1}. Hence it respects t, adjacent reductions and the level-zero maps to k. Give C_{i,n} its polynomial-truncation algebra structure through this equivalence. The quotient factor maps are surjective, their kernels are generated by t^{n+1}, and the level-zero isomorphisms are k-linear.

Apply the compatible local-to-global formal lifting theorem to the C_{i,n}. It gives proper flat finitely presented Z_n with cartesian transitions and compatible local stalk identifications. Transport the base of each Z_n from the polynomial truncation to R/P_n. Transporting a cartesian square along isomorphisms preserves the cartesian property.

The special-fibre isomorphism identifies dim Z_0 with dim X, so proper formal-curve algebraization applies. It provides a flat finitely presented H-projective Y/R and compatible isomorphisms of every jet with Z_n. The algebraization theorem includes quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness in its conclusion.

Paste the level-zero square with the quotient square to obtain the required special-fibre isomorphism over k. Compose the maps from X into Z_n with the algebraization isomorphisms to define j_n. The transition equations give their common composite to Y by induction. Compose the induced stalk isomorphisms with the prescribed formal-lifting stalk isomorphisms. Naturality of scalar-to-stalk maps under scheme morphisms proves h_{i,n}(a)=a on base scalars. This proves precisely the finite-jet comparison, with no claim about unreduced local rings.

theorem isolated_curve_local_algebraization
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (1 : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (r : ℕ) (p : Fin r → X) (hp : Function.Injective p)
    (hclosed : ∀ i, IsClosed ({p i} : Set X))
    (hsmooth : ∀ x ∉ Set.range p, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ Smooth (U.ι ≫ f))
    (B : Fin r → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (B i)] [∀ i, IsLocalRing (B i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra (PowerSeries k) (B i)] [∀ i, Algebra k (B i)]
    [∀ i, IsScalarTower k (PowerSeries k) (B i)]
    [∀ i, Module.Flat (PowerSeries k) (B i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra.EssFiniteType (PowerSeries k) (B i)]
    (eB : ∀ i,
      let : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk (p i)) :=
        (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top ≫
          X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (p i) trivial).hom.toAlgebra)
      (B i ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap (PowerSeries k) (B i) PowerSeries.X}) ≃ₐ[k]
        X.presheaf.stalk (p i)) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of (PowerSeries k))),
      Flat g ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation g ∧ QuasiCompact g ∧ QuasiSeparated g ∧
      IsHProjective g ∧
      ∃ e : pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k)))) ≅ X,
        e.hom ≫ f = pullback.snd g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k)))) ∧
      ∃ j : ∀ n, X ⟶ pullback g (formalCurveBaseι k n),
        (∀ n, j n ≫ pullback.fst g (formalCurveBaseι k n) =
          e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k))))) ∧
      ∃ h : ∀ i n,
        (pullback g (formalCurveBaseι k n)).presheaf.stalk (j n (p i))
          ≃+* (B i ⧸ Ideal.span
            {(algebraMap (PowerSeries k) (B i) PowerSeries.X) ^ (n + 1)}),
        ∀ i n a, h i n (isolatedCurveScalarToStalk
          (pullback.snd g (formalCurveBaseι k n)) (j n (p i))
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap _ _ a)
